inspectionModes: 112x121 pixelated right/left run strips at the renderer's 120/220 ms cadence

findings.model: cross-action eye/head scale and planted height use one canonical chibi proportion; no oversized running head
findings.palette: ash-silver/blonde hair has no purple or chroma-key pockets; coral-magenta is reserved for the eyes
findings.running: compact contact/load/pass/short-flight legs with visible contralateral cuff trajectories, bounded adjacent motion, warm near/far shading, and an exact whole-frame left mirror
findings.jump: crouch, launch, vertical apex tuck under pelvis, feet-down descent, and crouched landing absorption
findings.wave: same raised open hand in all frames; no finger-sign teleport
findings.failed: surprise to head droop to recovery with both arms retained
findings.look: clockwise 16-frame head/eye sequence with planted baseline and exact mirrored left half
